title.en: Miscellaneous Offences (Public Order and Nuisance) (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2015

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Miscellaneous Offences (Public Order and Nuisance) (Composition of Offences) Regulations 2015 and come into operation on 1 July 2015.

2. In accordance with section 243 of the Criminal Procedure Code (Cap. 68), a police officer of or above the rank of Assistant Superintendent of Police may compound any offence under section 14 of the Act by collecting from a person reasonably suspected of having committed the offence a sum not exceeding $500.
